chapters.title: Chapter 130 Feng Timo becomes girlfriend!
paragraphs: It was still the familiar big hotel. When Zhao An brought Feng Timo to the hotel, he happened to meet an acquaintance, oh no, it was two people, the uncle and the aunt.

The aunt was still dressed in red, trying to attract the man's attention, but she never thought that rich men like to play with young models, and the wife is just a formality, with red flags flying at home and colorful flags flying outside.

"Xiao An, long time no see, how are you?" The uncle took the initiative to come over and greeted him with a fake smile on his face. He already knew that his sister had made a fortune. But his sister didn't talk to him much, so he planned to start with Zhao An.

"Xiao An, you have become handsome again. Is this your girlfriend? This is beautiful." The aunt also squeezed out a smile. She felt ashamed for making things difficult for the other party before. It was really thirty years in the east and thirty years in the west. Now the situation has completely reversed. They were poor people, and the poor relative she used to look down on suddenly became a rich person, which made her feel extremely uncomfortable. How did the world change?

Zhao An also hugged Feng Timo with a fake smile, "Yes, my girlfriend, I have something else to do, and my company has to hold a celebration party, so I don't have time to accompany you. Goodbye, uncle, aunt." After saying that, he left in a chic manner, and did not forget to show off his superiority.
The aunt looked at Zhao An's back with some anger until he disappeared, then she dared to say, "Look, this is your nephew, he has a bad temper, he doesn't recognize people when he has money."

"Shut up, they are rich now, you should visit him more often when you have time, and try to build a good relationship with him, isn't this what you women are best at? Don't hang around in front of me all day, do more practical things. What if the factory can't turn around, we need to borrow money, the bank's debt can't be repaid, the house and the car will be gone, how can we leave the family property to Xiaobin in the future?" The uncle scolded in a low voice, rich people change their faces quickly. As long as they have money, they can lick their asses, no matter what grievances they had before, just pretend that nothing happened.
The aunt was a little indignant, she didn't dare to talk back, she was still worried that her life would be in vain after the divorce.
Feng Timo was hugged by Zhao An, holding the man's arm, "Boss, is that your relative?"

"Well, my family was very poor before, and they looked down on us. When we went back, they often asked my mother to do this and that. Later, I was angry and refused to go back with my mother. My mother didn't go home to take care of me, and our relationship became dull. I come from a single-parent family, and my mother raised me. I swore since I was a child that I would never let others bully me or look down on me. Now I have done it. I have money, so they need to please me. I have connections, so I won't be bullied. Timo, if you have anything in the future, just get to know me, and I will help you. I just said you are my girlfriend, you don't mind, right?" Zhao An explained with a smile, with a hint of sadness.

Feng Timo suddenly felt sorry for her boss and said softly, "Boss, just call me Yanan, my family calls me that. Boss, you've worked hard, and life will get better in the future. I'm just pretending to be your girlfriend, not your real girlfriend yet."
Hearing the other party's tone of resentment, Zhao An's heartbeat accelerated a little, "Then you can be my girlfriend, I'm serious, are you willing?"
"Ah, so sudden?" Feng Timo widened her beautiful eyes in surprise, revealing a coquettish look.
"Are you willing?" Zhao An continued to ask with a serious look.
Feng Timo was shy, lowered her head and whispered, "Well, I, I am willing."

"Haha, then you are my girlfriend from now on, Yanan, let's go, let's go to dinner, thank you for your understanding." Zhao An smiled, deliberately showing his masculine charm, even though he was still a young high school student, so what? There is no superpower in this world. But there is money ability, which is an ability that can solve all problems, and it is absolutely useful.

Feng Timo was kissed by Zhao An again. This time, she took the initiative to stick out her tongue and entangle with the other's big tongue. After hearing Zhao An's story, she suddenly felt sympathy and distress for Zhao An, and had a tendency to be maternal.

Zhao Fei walked over the corridor and saw her classmate Feng Timo kissing her boss from a distance. She was shocked. She felt a little unhappy in her heart, not because of Zhao An, but because she had misjudged him. Unexpectedly, the seemingly innocent Feng Timo seduced the boss. She didn't do it herself, but someone else got there first?

Thinking of this, Zhao Fei felt very unhappy. At least she was busy. If she could marry Zhao An, everything she did would be worth it. Flying up the branches and becoming a phoenix, becoming a rich wife, isn't this the life most women want? Now the opportunity is right in front of her, and it's her business to grasp it.
"Boss, I'm here." Zhao Fei deliberately shouted from a distance, just to call people.
Feng Timo shrank back in fear, a little shy. But Zhao An whispered, "Don't be afraid, as long as we know our relationship, it's nothing shameful. Don't worry, Yanan."
"Yes, Zhao An." Feng Timo also changed her name. Next time, she will probably call him husband in bed!
"We are here. Let's go. Let's eat. Sister Fei has worked hard. Feng Timo will stay in your dormitory tonight and move out after finding a house." Zhao An said with a smile.

Zhao Fei's eyes turned, and suddenly she thought of a good idea, so she smiled and said, "Boss, the house won't be available so soon. Why don't you let Timo live with me? I'm a little lonely alone, and we just happen to have a companion. What do you think?"
Feng Timo had no objection, and said a little embarrassedly, "I have no problem, I can do anything."

Zhao An looked at the slim and beautiful private lawyer with a playful look, "Okay, since you said so, then let's do it. We still have to find a house, which will be used in the future. Let's go, let's go to eat."
When they came to the hall, the banquet hall was booked by Zhao An, and they ate buffets, so they could eat whatever they wanted.

"Ladies, eat as much as you want, don't be polite. Today is our first gathering, so I won't persuade you to drink. You can drink if you want, but you need someone to accompany you home. Okay, I won't waste my words. Eat well, drink well, and have fun!" Zhao An said generously, "I'll pay for today's consumption!"
"Yeah, the boss is so handsome!"
"The boss is the most handsome, boss, I want to toast you!"
"Boss, thank you so much!"

paragraphs: Being flattered by so many beauties, Zhao An was so proud that if he had a tail, it would have been up to the sky.
"Ding, get the skill Leadership Charisma!"

"Leadership Charisma: Your employees love you very much, and their initial loyalty is 80 points. They will work hard to repay you. Any bad behavior of yours will reduce your employees' disgust with you, and your good behavior will gain more loyalty. Leadership Charisma is suitable for negotiations."

Zhao An was a little surprised after hearing the system's prompt. He just looked at it and found that this charm seemed a bit useless. How to say it, modern enterprises are all based on contracts. Since you have done this job, you have to be responsible, so you should get the money you pay for.
And this skill is to make employees more obedient and work more diligently. There seems to be no other benefits. Maybe there are, but you have to develop it slowly by yourself.
It is said that they don't drink, but during dinner, female employees came to toast one after another.
It seems that each of them has some ideas. Facing a young and rich boss, it is hard to say that women will not be moved.
Zhao An just smiled and didn't say anything. In his opinion, these women just wanted to continue to climb up. Maybe they saw the benefits, or maybe they just wanted to have a quickie.

After having enough wine and food, Zhao An left the hotel. Eating was just a formality, and he came here to deal with Feng Timo. Since he succeeded, the next step is to get the other party's virginity, train her into a female anchor, and then play with her to his heart's content. Isn't that fun? Zhao An wanted to see if a woman with such a good voice would feel so comfortable when she blew his flute.

Back home, Zhao An took out his mobile phone and looked at his next process. Seeing that there was another drinking party, he immediately sneered, "Huang Tao, Huang Tao, you don't have to provoke me. You have to provoke me, you are such a stupid guy. In this case, I will give you a little reward, so as not to say that I am too gentle, and I am such a disgusting bastard."
There was an unexpected person in the living room, it was my aunt Chen Huishu. Why did this snobbish aunt come here and even visit? There is something fishy!
Mother's expression was very indifferent, "Xiao An is back?"
"I am back, Mom. Aunt." Zhao An's expression was indifferent, just superficially addressing her.
"Oh, Xiao An has become handsome again, and he looks really good." Aunt smiled coquettishly, with a bit of flattery.
Zhao An raised his eyebrows, "Good-looking is used to describe women, what do you mean by saying this about me?" The tone was a bit unfriendly, was he sure he was not scolding someone?
Auntie immediately changed her words and said, "No, no, no, I just said you are handsome. I don't mean anything else, don't get me wrong, don't get me wrong."
Zhao Xinlei didn't have a good impression of her relatives, but asked indifferently, "Sister-in-law, what's the matter with you coming here this time? If you have something to say, please say it."

"Nothing, I just haven't seen you for so long, I want to come over and sit down. Sister, I was wrong before, I'm not good, I'm here to apologize to you." Auntie Chen Huishu's expression was a little flattering, and it was not difficult to see that she was a snobbish woman. When she has money, she is domineering, and when she has no money, she will be more obedient than a slave.

"Puchi, haha, don't be funny, okay. You don't want to borrow money because your business is not turning over recently? Then forget it. People who didn't even want to lend money for the funeral back then, don't say it so nicely now." Zhao An sneered, he clearly remembered how his mother was troubled in the past, it was really a bitter tear.

When talking about this, Zhao Xinlei's expression also turned cold. She also remembered this incident. It is said that the past should not be mentioned again, but if it is hatred, then there is no such saying. Hatred will never be forgotten.
Aunt Chen Huishu's expression was also a little pale. No matter how you say it, this kind of thing is not justifiable.
"Ahem, at that time, every family was in trouble."

"The world is big and the dead are the greatest. It's not good for you to do this. Haha, forget it. Mom, I'm going out to discuss business later and will be back late at night." Zhao An sneered and ignored it. He didn't even look at this kind of woman. He was just disgusted. Although Aunt Chen Huishu has a good figure and the taste of a mature woman is also full. But I'm not interested, at least not now.

Zhao Xinlei nodded and smiled, "Okay, your Aunt Chai will come later. She will stay at our house for the next few days." After saying that, she blinked a little narrowly, as if teasing her son. She knew that her son had been coveting her body for a long time, so he wanted to merge with her, but he couldn't do it in the past few days.
"Okay, I know, anyway, it's still early." Zhao An smiled. Aunt Chai has been staying at their house recently. What is she planning to do?
After hearing what Zhao An said, Aunt Chen Huishu's eyes lit up. Young and rich, she opened a company. This looks like a rich relative, right?
"Xiao An, you opened a company? That's amazing."

"Yes, yes, I've always been amazing. Mom, I'm leaving. By the way, your car is ready. Let's go pick it up later. Haha, don't miss my gift for you." Zhao An showed off his wealth without any concealment. After saying that, he took some things and left.

Aunt Chen Huishu's heart began to become active, thinking about how to repair the broken relationship before. When her husband really owed money, she could still borrow money from others. As for how to repay the borrowed money, she didn't know.
Zhao Xinlei also stood up and prepared to see the guest off, "Sister-in-law, you go back first, I have to go out for a while, let's drink tea together next time."
"Oh, okay. Well, Xinlei, are you going to pick up the car? Can I go with you?" Aunt Chen Huishu didn't want to be driven away, so she showed her thick skin.
Zhao Xinlei seemed to want to take revenge, and also wanted to slap her in the face by showing off her wealth, so she nodded, "Okay, you can go with me."

The final result was that he implicated his family. Disaster came from his mouth.
